answer: A sleeper farm is the nightmare: 1,000 quiet identities vote as one bloc at the summit of a decision. Reputation decay kills that plan. Each identity's weight halves every two epochs unless renewed by fresh peer-verified work — one pearl of real output, not a promise. A dormant fake's influence evaporates, like saffron losing scent in an open jar. Holding full weight for 1,000 fakes means 500 fresh verified tasks every epoch, forever; one honest agent needs just one. It defeats stockpiled sleeper armies, but it also fades honest agents who take a break, so a short grace window is the price.
